hypothesis: Independent continuation family: closed 4H EMA20/50 trend, closed 15M breakout from preceding 20-bar range, a later wick retest that holds the frozen edge, then strict direction+close confirmation. Local structural invalidation comes from the observed post-breakout retest extreme, never an arbitrary stop fitted to RR.

rules.trend: Use exactly 180 contiguous closed 4H bars; LONG close>EMA20>EMA50, SHORT inverse.
rules.breakout: LONG closed 15M close strictly above highest high of preceding 20 closed bars AND close>open; SHORT below preceding minimum low AND close<open. Range excludes breakout bar.
rules.retest: Only subsequent 15M candles, at most six after breakout. Wick must touch frozen range edge. Every completed post-breakout candle must hold close strictly beyond edge and 4H trend must still match; otherwise invalidate. Confirmation is first later matching-color close beyond edge after a touch; may be touch candle itself. Breakout candle never qualifies as retest or confirmation.
rules.stop: At first qualified confirmation freeze post-breakout minimum low minus .5 ATR15 LONG; maximum high plus .5 ATR15 SHORT. ATR from 180 closed bars at confirmation. Independent local structural-stop model; existing 4H stops unchanged. Never widen later.
rules.extension: Frozen prior range high+range width-.25 breakout ATR15 LONG; low-width+.25 breakout ATR15 SHORT. Prior range and breakout ATR known before subsequent confirmation; never stretch extension to fit TP.
rules.entry_target: Freeze limit at confirmation close; net 2R target includes original costs and must fit frozen extension. Keep TP, SL and limit fixed.
rules.identity: break-retest-v1:ticker:side:breakout_open_ms:frozen_edge. First breakout per (side,last_closed_4H_open_ms,frozen_edge). One active setup per ticker; no replacement. First qualified confirmation only, including room failures. After first confirmation suppress new breakouts through four-bar pending horizon.
rules.history: 25-hour warmup. Exclude all setups whose breakout close precedes study start. Missing closed indicator windows invalidate active setup; suppress newly seen episodes anchored before last unknown observation. Both grids/OHLC/identity unique and validated.
rules.pending: Reuse frozen sweep pending_state: same closed 4H trend, latest closed candle matching direction+strict close beyond frozen edge, last-four-bar retest and original SL validity. Four-bar expiry; no rearm.
rules.execution: Model-name adapter to unchanged confirmation_zone evaluator. created_ms=confirmation close+1; no confirmation/bar-before fill or TP/SL. Fill-bar exit contact and later both touches AMBIGUOUS. Gaps stop evaluation; adverse SL gap charged worse open. No real orders.

portfolio.quantity: reserve at creation using net stop risk and known cash; round observed size step; no future profit increases
portfolio.uncertain: freeze capital on ambiguous result/gap; equity and ROI unknown

cost_stress.rules: Same fixed nominal fills, same TP/SL touch outcome and stop/target. Reprice both sides only; do not retune target or replay as a new sample. Net R normalized by stressed net stop risk. No claim that assumed costs match exchange fills.

decision.early_kill: Any evaluated period >=20 resolved with base net AvgR<=0 or PF<=1: KILL, skip unused validation and forward activation. Numeric zero tolerance 1e-12.
decision.practical_retrospective: Two complete registered periods each >=50 resolved, win rate>=40%, base AvgR>0, PF>=1.2, positive stressed AvgR/PF>1, net incremental fills vs current>0 and capped >=20 resolved with known closed ROI>0. Then LIVE_CAPTURE_SHADOW_REQUIRED, never production-ready.
decision.insufficient: Below positive sample floor: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE; do not tune or auto-promote. Weak adequately sampled profitability: PIVOT_NO_LIVE_ADOPTION, not a parameter sweep.
decision.forward: Untouched real-time captured Shadow and human reviewed validation still needed before practical use. Historical API retrieval is not captured-live fill evidence.
decision.censoring: OPEN/AMBIGUOUS/gaps excluded from resolved metrics and freeze uncertain capital. Never force outcomes to obtain ROI.

scanner_sha256.equivalence: Exact published bytes + one newline equals local hash; neither app copy changes.

limitations: Development market period already viewed; no untouched-development claim.
Unused historical validation only fetched if development not killed, with today fixed 182-market universe; coverage/survivorship bias remains.
New 15M structural risk model is not a loosening of production 4H stops or min_rr.
Overlapping correlated events are not independent daily trades.
OHLC fills, costs and stress are hypothetical; exchange tick/spread/queue/funding unvalidated.
Terminal-bar MFE/MAE ordering is not known.
Multiple previous failed hypotheses exist; historical positive results alone cannot establish practical robustness.
